objective: The exact search (lattice tori up to 24 points, conditionally to 32, and the composed genus-2 space) and, if a five-input parity space exists, the frozen learning runs.
status: Proved 2026-11-11 (exact): no five-input parity on 421 lattice tori up to 24 points or on the composed genus-2 space; three-input parity only on 16 tori of 8 to 18 points; the second torus unties the host's wire (after the run). Stage 1b dropped by rule; learning not run.
title: Five-input parity: exact search and learning
